name: filter-schema
title: Filter Schema
description: Typed filters declared once: defineFilters with text, options, boolean, number, date, dateRange and remoteOption fields, FilterValues inferred from it, a canonical AST, serializers for query params, JSON, RSQL, OData, Spring Filter, GraphQL where and q-only search, and a URL codec that round-trips readable params.
docs: `defineFilters({ status: { kind: "options", label, options, multiple: true }, … })` is the whitelist: keys and wire `field` names must be identifiers, and nothing a person types becomes a field name. `FilterValues<typeof schema>` types the values. `toFilterAst(schema, values)` joins the active ones into a `FilterNode` (`and`, `or`, `not`, `{ field, op, value }`); text fields send `{ param: "q" }` by default (read with `searchTerms`) or match `{ fields, op: "contains" }`, joined by `or`. A date range's end is inclusive: `lte` the last day, or `end: "next-day"` for `lt` the day after when the backend stores date-times. `$where` adds an expression with groups, checked against `schemaFields(schema)`. Serializers, each its own module: `queryParams(ast, { style: "suffix" | "dto" | "bracket" })` (and only), `jsonAst` (POST body), `rsql`, `odata` (`$filter`), `springFilter` (turkraft), `graphqlWhere` (`dialect: "hasura" | "prisma"`) and `searchOnly`. Each escapes per its grammar and throws a `FilterSerializeError` for what it can't write safely, like a wildcard inside a text match. Dates are ISO 8601 by default (`dates: "iso" | "iso-date" | "epoch-ms" | fn`), from strings, `Date` or Temporal values. `matchesFilter(ast, item)` evaluates a filter in memory. `createUrlCodec(schema, { prefix, format, defaults })` keeps schema values, not the wire format, in readable params (`?status=open,closed&created=2026-01-01..2026-02-01&page=2&sort=name.asc`), one encoded `f` param when `$where` has groups, and drops anything a tampered URL puts there that doesn't fit. `parseFilterInput(field, input)` reads loose input (option labels, `"yes"`, `">= 10"`, `"2026-01-01..2026-01-31"`) into a field's value and `findFilterKey(schema, name)` finds a field by key or label, for agents and command palettes.
